# Hand-checkable case shared by the Python tests and the Java SelfCheck.
# vm <mips> <price_per_second> <host_id>
vm 1000 0.001 0
vm 500 0.0005 1
# host <id> <p_idle_w> <p_max_w>
host 0 100 200
host 1 50 100
# task <length_mi> <arrival_s> <deadline_s>
task 2000 0 3
task 1000 0 1.5
task 1000 1 2.5
# a fixed assignment (VM index per task) and its hand-computed objectives
assign 0 1 0
expect makespan 3.0
expect energy 850.0
expect cost 0.004
expect imbalance 0.2
expect sla 0.6666666667
# what the baseline schedulers must produce on this instance
expect_fcfs 0 1 0
expect_minmin 0 0 0
